newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News says Ansett has difficult half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News says Ansett has difficult half.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said on Thursday its 50 percent owned airline Ansett Airlines continued to experience difficult trading conditions in both domestic and international markets during the six months ended December 31, 1996.
News Corp said Ansett's international operations reported a loss in the first half.

"Ansett's international operations reported a loss for the half year due to a stronger Australian dollar against the Yen, aggressive competition in the Japanese market and significant start up costs related to the Seoul and Jakarta operations," News Corp said.
News Corp did not give any figures for the Ansett results in a statement accompanying the group's half year results. Air New Zealand Ltd owns the other 50 percent of Ansett.
Ansett reported an operating loss before tax of A$18.6 million for the year to June 30, 1996.
